name: Classic Margherita
steps: Roll out the pizza dough on a floured surface.
Spread an even layer of tomato sauce over the dough.
Top with mozzarella cheese and fresh basil leaves.
Drizzle with olive oil.
Bake at 250C for 8-10 minutes until the crust is golden.

name: Pepperoni Feast
steps: Stretch the dough into a 12-inch round.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over the base.
Sprinkle mozzarella cheese, then arrange pepperoni slices.
Dust with dried oregano.
Bake at 240C for 10-12 minutes until pepperoni edges are crisp.

name: BBQ Chicken Pizza
steps: Shape the pizza dough into a round.
Spread BBQ sauce instead of tomato as the base.
Add diced cooked chicken breast and thinly sliced red onions.
Cover with mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 240C for 10-12 minutes.
Top with fresh cilantro before serving.

name: Veggie Delight
steps: Prepare the dough and pre-bake for 3 minutes.
Spread tomato sauce over the partially baked crust.
Layer mozzarella, then sliced bell peppers, mushrooms, red onions, and olives.
Bake at 240C for 8-10 minutes until vegetables are tender.

name: Four Cheese Pizza
steps: Roll out the dough and place on a baking stone.
Spread a thin layer of tomato sauce.
Distribute mozzarella, parmesan, crumbled gorgonzola, and goat cheese evenly.
Bake at 250C for 8-10 minutes until cheeses are bubbling and golden.
